summary: Rambus Inc. filed an 8-K reporting results of its 2026 annual meeting of stockholders held April 23, 2026. Shareholders voted on election of three Class I directors, ratification of auditor KPMG LLP, and an advisory vote on executive compensation. All proposals passed. The registrant also disclosed board committee composition changes, including renaming the Cyber Risk Committee to the AI and Cyber Risk Committee. This filing is a routine current report on shareholder votes and board administrative actions, not a special situation event. There are no deal terms, strategic changes, or corporate actions to analyze.
